name: site-footer
title: Site footer
description: Brand and a call-us card, five dense link columns, then trust marks, legal links and an age notice.
author: themes.dev

award, in that order. */ export type TrustMark = { label: string; note: string; icon?: LucideIcon } export type SiteFooterProps = { brand: LinkRef /** The icon before the wordmark. */ mark: LucideIcon tagline: string service: { title: string; hours: string; phone: string; shops: LinkRef } /** The first group is the shop: it gets two columns of links. */ groups: LinkGroup[] trust: TrustMark[] copyright: string legal: LinkRef[] /** The round badge with two lines beside the legal links; `null` leaves it out. */ age: { mark: string; lines: string[] } | null } export const siteFooterDefaults:
